overview: This enum controls how an attack updates the character's secondary aim target when attacks or targets change.

None.simple: This attack leaves the secondary aim target alone when one attack follows another.
None.technical: FGameDataTableRow_Attack::TargetChangeType defaults to EGameTargetChangeType::None. StartAttackHoming skips the secondary-target copy on an attack-to-attack transition. IsTargetChangeAlways returns false, so OnTargetChanged leaves the secondary target alone. A fresh action that did not follow an attack still copies the primary target into the secondary target.

AttackActivate.simple: This attack copies the current target when it starts after another attack.
AttackActivate.technical: On an attack-to-attack StartAttackHoming, AttackActivate makes Owner.SetSecondaryTarget use GetTargetActor. IsTargetChangeAlways returns false, so later OnTargetChanged calls leave the secondary target unchanged.

Always.simple: This attack follows the current target when it starts and whenever the target changes.
Always.technical: On an attack-to-attack StartAttackHoming, Always makes Owner.SetSecondaryTarget use GetTargetActor. IsTargetChangeAlways returns true, so OnTargetChanged calls SetSecondaryTarget with NewTarget. FCP_170_CursedEnergyAttack_2 overrides IsTargetChangeAlways to return false at ChargePhase 3.

Invalid.simple: This value is a reserved invalid marker.
Invalid.technical: Declared as the uint8 slot 255 in the enum header. No source consumer in this checkout compares TargetChangeType with Invalid, so its intended runtime behavior is unresolved.

notes: The field writes the secondary aim target through SetSecondaryTarget. The primary target remains the value returned by GetTargetActor.
When the previous action is not an attack, StartAttackHoming copies the primary target into the secondary target regardless of TargetChangeType.
bUpdateHomingLocation controls location refresh on attack-to-attack transitions. It is a separate field from TargetChangeType.
The supplied AttackDataTable exports contain None, AttackActivate, and Always. No exported row uses Invalid.
The header declares no aliases for this enum.
